name: "You talk too much" Start a podcast.

lines.ref:
"You talk too much"
Start a podcast.

"You ask too many questions"
Become a researcher.

"You always film everything"
Become a content creator.

shots.brief: Drinking coffee or talking casually at home (ref: Creator standing in kitchen, drinking from a mug and gesturing while talking; tripod)
Admiring or gesturing at wall art (ref: Creator pointing at an art wall hanging/tapestry and gesturing; filmed by friend)
Writing in a notebook or studying at a desk (ref: Creator wearing sunglasses writing intensely in a journal at a desk; tripod)
Walking outside on a street or sidewalk (ref: Creator sipping water from a plastic bottle and walking down a sidewalk alongside a stone wall; filmed by friend)
Casual selfie video out with a friend (ref: Creator filming selfie video smiling and flashing peace signs while friend sits in background at an arcade/mall; selfie)
Working on a laptop or computer from behind (ref: Over-the-shoulder view of creator working at a computer desk and typing on a keyboard; filmed by friend)
Walking towards camera outdoors at golden hour (ref: Creator walking forward towards the camera on a quiet street at sunset, smiling and grooving to the music; filmed by friend)

audit.notes: This template works with almost any existing lifestyle library. Swap the 7 b-roll clips with simple shots from your archive (e.g. morning coffee, museum visit, journal writing, walking in the city, laptop work, smiling outside) and overlay your reframed mindset text.
audit.summary: A motivational montage reframing common personal criticisms into productive strengths and career opportunities, paired with casual daily lifestyle b-roll clips.
